info.title: ProdBnb Admin API
info.description: The /v1/admin/* surface only (Phase 11; Admin Console). Every endpoint requires a Supabase access token for a user holding the 'admin' role, and each names the admin team-role permission it needs (see GET /me). Base path is mounted at /v1/admin on the ProdBnb backend.

placeholders.description: Bracketed placeholders still in the text, e.g. "[Company legal name]".

missing.description: What's still needed before invoices can be issued
